verdict.rationale: Zapier MCP explicitly enables natural-language commands: 'Describe what you need in plain language. Your AI calls the right Zapier action and confirms what it did' and 'Schedule a meeting with one prompt,' letting AI clients trigger 40,000+ actions across 9,000+ apps via governed MCP connections. This is well-documented first-party functionality with a dedicated product page, though independent hands-on validation of the natural-language flow itself is absent. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of the MCP natural-language experience specifically (community evidence covers classic Zap-building, not the AI prompt-driven flow).
